description: This file contains functions and setup procedures for configuring, renewing, and tearing down DHCPv6 protocol in a network device, including initialization, prefix and option handling, and protocol registration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 configuration parameters with default values and options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to a given list or string.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 configuration if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration for a specified interface, including options and environment variables.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Forces renewal of DHCPv6 lease via signal.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills DHCPv6 process for a specified interface.
